program.ge_pattern: Columbia College General Education (CC-GE) Pattern or California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC) Pattern
outcomes: Create and edit a variety of digital media
Analyze different forms of digital media

notes: The page layout prints each unit value on the line after its course (a stray '0 units' precedes ART15 and '3 units' follows MEDIA26); units were assigned by matching each course to the value printed after it, which agrees with the closed list.

The Required Courses list totals 46 units but the block says 'Complete the following number of units: 37' with the note 'Cross-listed courses will only meet a requirement for one of the two subject areas.' ART51/MEDIA14, ART53/MEDIA10 and ART56/MEDIA16 are cross-listed pairs; 46 minus 9 = 37, so in effect the student takes every course with one course from each cross-listed pair. Recorded as choose_units 37 as printed; a reviewer may prefer modeling the pairs as alternatives under an 'all' rule.
Degree total of 60 taken from '37.0 Major Units | 60 Total Units Required'; the page prints no units for the GE pattern.

The description ends with the lead-in 'Upon satisfactory completion of this award, the student should be prepared to:' with nothing under it; outcomes were taken from the Program Learning Outcomes section.

Careers left empty: the description names only 'entry-level jobs in one of the many fields of media and design' and application areas (entertainment, marketing, advertising, education, training) for digital content, not specific careers; reviewer may wish to check.
